name: AgentCompass
description: Route work with AgentCompass and collect exact Cindy task results. Requires the experimental public tasks API.
whenToUse: Delegate independent work through AgentCompass from a Cindy Claude, Codex or Pi session.

tools.name: roll
tools.description: Route the full task unchanged and start one exact Cindy catalog route. Requires experimental tasks capabilities and a matching configured plugin task directory. Returns an operation and a concrete status-tool call; no automatic callback. Never supply session_context yourself.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Collect the same operation. Reads durable host runs and paged messages; saves full output on disk and returns the exact final message summary. Unknown delivery is observed, never resent.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Cancel this plugin's run through Cindy's official scoped cancel API. Stopping or reconciling does not guarantee termination; collect status until terminal.

tools.name: cleanup
tools.description: Archive this plugin's completed, failed or cancelled task. Refuses active runs. Does not delete history or signal arbitrary processes.
